title: Making a part of a traced drawing smaller shrinks all of it cleanly, rays and all, with nothing showing through
goal: When Ask has drawn an icon (a sun over a hill) and you ask it to make the sun smaller, today only the sun disc shrinks: its rays stay full size and the green hill layer that the tracing put under the sun shows through as a thick ring. The whole sun should shrink and the space it leaves should look like the background around it.
notes: Reproduced: node Scripts/ask-eval/followup.mjs run --run after-5 --cases icon-sun-smaller (code bb3ea1fb). Model called change_part with part Sun and at, a point in the disc. Judge: "The yellow sun disc did get smaller, but the space it left was filled with a thick green ring instead of the background, the rays stayed at their original size and position, and the top of the hill bulges upward" (part 5 words 6 rest 4). Pictures: .ask-eval/followups/after-5/icon-sun-smaller/first.png and second.png. Layer tree of that icon: Green [path] covers 43,138 426x294 (under the sun), Yellow (disc) plus Yellow 2..13 and Pale yellow 1..6 (rays and highlights) as separate colour layers. splitPiece (Sources/PhotonzCore/AgentPartChange.swift) takes only the smallest ring at the point. Ideas: gather pieces of the same and near colours within a radius of the picked piece; or cut the hole out of the layer beneath. Found while running ask-changes-what-it-just-made-make-the-water-blu.
acceptance: On a drawing traced into colour layers, a change_part with a point inside one piece also takes the other pieces of the same part (a sun disc and its rays), found by a general rule, never by coded subject words
Shrinking or removing a traced piece leaves what was around it showing, not a lower colour layer that the trace filled in underneath
The two-turn eval case icon-sun-smaller passes when its first request makes a drawing
Recolouring a named part of a traced drawing ('make her robe a darker green' on a traced Statue of Liberty) changes that part's pieces in all their shades and leaves the face and arm as they were

log.note: also recolouring: on a traced Statue of Liberty (205 pieces named Teal, Pale teal, Dark teal...), 'make her robe a darker green' now plans and lands (task ask-never-fails-because-a-document-is-too-big-to), but the model picks the colour group 'Pale teal', so the pale highlights across robe, face and arm turn flat dark green while the robe's other shades stay. A point (at) would take one piece of a robe made of about a hundred. Reproduced 2026-10-31 with /tmp-style walk: blank 1440x1024, Ask 'draw the Statue of Liberty', then 'make her robe a darker green'; trace showed change_part {part: 'Pale teal', layer: <group>, color: #2E6B5E}. Before/after in queue/audits/2026-10-31-ask-big-drawing-before-after.png.
